summary: Talen Energy Corp filed an 8-K announcing an amendment to its credit agreement executed on May 20, 2026. The amendment reprices and extends maturities for its term loan B facilities and revolving credit facility: the Initial Term B Facility ($846M) matures May 2030 to November 2032; the 2024-1 Incremental Term B Facility ($839M) repriced; the Revolving Credit Facility ($900M) repriced. Interest margins were reduced: ABR margin to 0.75% (term loans) and 0.50% (revolver); Term SOFR margin to 1.75% (term loans) and 1.50% (revolver). No special-situation event; routine financing activity.
